author: battibass
body:
This PR removes discrepancies that were observed when producing low-pT electrons NANOAOD branches using the following workflows:

- **Mini v2/v4** -> **NANO v15**
- **Mini v2/v4** -> **Mini v6** -> **NANO v15**

with the second one implying persisting **Mini v6** data produced from earlier Mini versions.

Results from the comparisons ran for different Run 2 and Run 3 years are available [at this page](https://battilan.web.cern.ch/battilan/crossPOG/MINI2MINI/2026_sep_03_ppd_talk/).
In particular, the present fix improves agreement in all Run 2 (data and MC) workflows, Run 3 ones are not affected.

Overall, the status of workflows persisting **Mini v6** were [presented at PPD General on September 3rd](https://indico.cern.ch/event/1711141/#2-xpog-review-of-miniaod-conte).
title: Add low-pT electrons NANO modifier for Run2 mini2mini
